name: De Montfort University
description:
Do you want to study at a university that has attained the highest possible standard in the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) for its world-class teaching?

De Montfort University offers to reward eligible prospective international students with the International Scholarship Award for 2023/24 if they are enrolled for a full-time or part-time degree.

The DMU's award-winning Careers Team has already helped students to gain industry experience with companies such as ASOS, Disney, and Rolls-Royce, amongst others! 

De Montfort University was named the first-ever University of the Year for Social Inclusion and also enjoyed its ranking among the top 50 universities in the world for sustainability by the Times Higher Education University Impact Rankings.

The most popular De Montfort University courses are as follows:

  • BA (Hons) Business Management 
  • BSc (Hons) Computer Science
  • BA (Hons) Business and Marketing

Are you anxious about adapting to a new country and academic setting? Do you have questions about whether your chosen university provides resources that recognise and aid students from various backgrounds? Perhaps you're curious to know if attending this university increases your opportunities for securing a favourable international job after graduation?

Discover why De Montfort University might just be the place for you!

View courses now

There has been significant investment in recent years to ensure the De Montfort campus has the modern facilities needed to provide the right education. Business students can enjoy the restored Great Hall of Leicester Castle, while the spectacular Vijay Patel Building is home to art and design students.

Benefits of studying De Montfort University

De Montfort University is based in Leicester and has its origins in the Leicester School of Art, which was established in 1870. Over the years it merged with other colleges and by the late 1960s it was the City of Leicester Polytechnic. In 1992 it became De Montfort University and today it has around 30,000 students including international students from more than 130 countries.

It is ranked in the top 800 global universities in the Times Higher Education rankings. It is also in the top 120 UK universities by the Complete University Guide, The Guardian and The Times/Sunday Times. In the Times Higher Education University Impact Rankings it was rated 50th in the world for sustainability.

Why De Montfort University?

The university participates in groundbreaking research, such as:

  • The development of an AI assistant for older people to manage their health better
  • A development that turns waste cooking oil into biofuel
  • Exploring funding cuts at third-sector organisations 

Picture yourself completing your studies at De Montfort University, equipped with the skills, networks, and self-assurance to thrive in your desired profession. Visualise the sense of accomplishment that comes with earning a degree from a top-notch university celebrated for its excellence. Envision the freedom, personal development, and opportunities that come with university life.

Transform this vision into your actual journey.

Become part of the numerous students worldwide who have found their path to success at De Montfort University.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: De Montfort University (DMU) is based in Leicester and has its origins in the Leicester School of Art, which was established in 1870. Over the years, it merged with other colleges and by the late 1960s, it was the City of Leicester Polytechnic. In 1992 it became De Montfort University and today it has around 30,000 students including international students from more than 130 countries.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value:
De Montfort's International Student Support Team provides support before, during and after students join the program. This includes an international welcome week, free airport pick-ups and a buddy scheme, matching international students with local students. There is also free English language support for up to 2 hours a week.

The cost of living in Leicester is low: Leicester was ranked among the top 10 most affordable cities for students to live in the UK, according to a NatWest survey in 2021. It is around 25% cheaper than London on average and only one hour away by train.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
New international students who are enrolled full-time on DMU are guaranteed accommodation by De Montfort University.

International students have 9 different halls of residence to choose from that are all self-catered. All accommodation is within easy walking distance of the redeveloped campus.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Sports
The University’s Leisure team offers various sports and wellbeing activities on campus. These include a swimming pool, a climbing wall, a fitness suite, a dance studio, and many more facilities.

Laboratory
There are multiple facilities including the MTI Research Lab, Diffusion Laboratory, Audiovisual/5.1 Laboratory, Sound Art Laboratory, and many more.

Cafeteria
The Food Village is the university’s main dining facility, located at the heart of the campus. Additionally, DMU's official catering partner, Chartwells, operates a number of food outlets across the campus.
